zh: 我小时候住在一个小城市，经常在河边玩。
old_en: When I was a child, I used to play by the river.
new_en: When I was a child, I lived in a small city and often played by the river.

zh: 小时候放学后我常去小卖部买零食。
old_en: When I was a kid, I used to go to the corner store after school to get snacks.
new_en: When I was a kid, I used to go to the corner store after school to get snacks.

zh: 我小时候一放学就去小卖部买零食。
old_en: When I was a kid, I used to rush to the corner store as soon as school was over to get snacks.
new_en: When I was a kid, I would rush to the corner store for snacks as soon as school was over.

zh: 小时候寒假我常去外婆家过年。
old_en: When I was a kid, I used to go to my grandma's house during winter vacation to celebrate the New Year.
new_en: When I was a kid, I used to go to my grandma's house during winter vacation to celebrate the New Year.

zh: 我小时候每年寒假都去外婆家过年。
old_en: When I was a kid, I used to go to my grandma's house every winter vacation to celebrate the New Year.
new_en: When I was a kid, I went to my grandma's house every winter vacation to celebrate the New Year.

zh: 我小时候学骑自行车，摔了好几次。
old_en: When I was a kid, I used to learn to ride a bicycle and fell off a few times.
new_en: When I was a kid, I learned to ride a bike and fell off a few times.

zh: 小时候学自行车时我摔过很多次。
old_en: When I was a kid, I used to fall off my bicycle many times while learning to ride it.
new_en: When I was a kid, I fell off my bike many times while learning to ride.

zh: 小时候我们家院子里养过小动物。
old_en: When I was a kid, we used to keep little animals in the yard.
new_en: When I was a kid, we kept little animals in our yard.

zh: 小时候暑假我每天去游泳。
old_en: When I was a kid, I used to go swimming every day during summer vacation.
new_en: When I was a kid, I went swimming every day during summer break.

zh: 小时候我们家住在一座小城市，我常去河边玩。
old_en: When I was a kid, we used to live in a small town, and I would often play by the river.
new_en: When I was a kid, we lived in a small city and I often played by the river.

zh: 小时候夏天我和邻居孩子常玩捉迷藏。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to play hide-and-seek with my neighbors in summer.
new_en: When I was a kid, I played hide-and-seek with my neighbors in summer.

zh: 我小时候一到夏天，就和邻居的孩子捉迷藏。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to hide and seek with the neighborhood kids in summer.
new_en: When summer came, I played hide-and-seek with the neighborhood kids.

zh: 小时候每天早上都是妈妈叫醒我。
old_en: When I was growing up, mom used to wake me up every morning.
new_en: When I was a kid, mom woke me up every morning.

zh: 我小时候妈妈每天很早叫我们起床。
old_en: When I was growing up, my mom used to wake us up very early every day.
new_en: When I was a kid, my mom woke us up very early every day.

zh: 我小时候喜欢在院子里养小鸡。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to keep little chickens in the yard.
new_en: When I was a kid, I liked keeping little chickens in the yard.

zh: 小时候我常和哥哥抢电视看。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to fight with my brother over the TV.
new_en: When I was a kid, I often fought with my brother over the TV.

zh: 我小时候和哥哥总为看电视吵架。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to argue with my brother over TV time.
new_en: When I was a kid, I used to argue with my brother about TV time.

zh: 小时候考试前我常熬夜复习。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to stay up late to study before exams.
new_en: When I was a kid, I often stayed up late to study before exams.

zh: 我小时候一到考试就熬夜看书。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to stay up late studying for exams.
new_en: When I was a kid, I used to stay up late studying for exams.

zh: 我小时候一到暑假就天天去游泳。
old_en: When I was growing up, I used to go swimming every day during summer break.
new_en: When I was a kid, I used to go swimming every day during summer break.
